text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... Good work today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You must be tired too, Trainer. Please 
take it easy today—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... haah...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Oguri-chan, are you on your way back 
from training too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Creek... No, I just came back to grab 
a light snack."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So, you're planning to run again 
tonight...?
choice_data_list: Isn't it dangerous to run alone at night?
Isn't it dangerous to run alone at night?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will watch out for cars. There is no 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm still worried, though.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, would it be alright if I tagged 
along with Oguri-chan too?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If we're together, I think we'll be able 
to handle anything that happens right 
away, and...
choice_data_list: It gets dark underfoot at night, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If we're together, I think we'll be able 
to handle anything that happens right 
away, and...
choice_data_list: It gets dark underfoot at night, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "My. Thank you very much, Trainer♪"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me. Thank you for your 
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No need, we're friends after all♪

"And so, Super Creek went to night 
training together with Oguri Cap."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Still, if it's just a little bit—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No way... If Oguri-chan got hurt on the 
streets at night, I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu... I'm going to cry!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
!? I-I'm sorry! We'll stop for today! So 
please, don't cry—

Though Oguri Cap was flustered, Super 
Creek offered a warm, reassuring smile.
